subject: general
question: ________is a type of turning where a workpiece is turned into a sequence of steps with varying diameters.
solution:
The correct answer is __Step Turning**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Step turning__ is a machining process performed on a lathe machine.
 
• It involves turning a cylindrical workpiece into a series of steps with different diameters.
 
• Step turning requires precise measurements for creating specific step lengths and diameters.
 
• This process is commonly used for shafts and other stepped components.
 
• The tool is fed parallel to the axis of the workpiece to achieve the desired dimensions.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Knurling:**

 
 
• It is a process of creating a textured pattern on a cylindrical surface for better grip.
 
• Knurling tools are used to press patterns into the material surface.
 
 
 
• **Facing: **
 
 
• It is the process of machining the end of a workpiece to make it flat and perpendicular to its axis.
 
• Facing is performed using a lathe machine to achieve a smooth surface.
 
 
 
• **Chamfering:**
 
 
• It involves removing sharp edges or corners of a workpiece to create a beveled surface.
 
• Chamfering improves the aesthetics and safety of the component.
